title: writetimetable
summary: Write a timetable to a delimited text file.

gpu_support.notes: Timetable data is serialized on the host. Automatically resident values gather transparently; explicit gpuArray input requires RunMat mode.

description: `writetimetable(TT, filename)` writes timetable row times and variables to a delimited text file.
behaviors: Row times are emitted as a leading `Time` field.
Variables from all eight native integer classes are serialized with their exact decimal values.
A typed-integer `WriteVariableNames` value, explicit `gpuArray` input, and the bytes-written output are available in RunMat mode.
